name: Kiln Waster: Jian-Ware Tea Bowl Fused to the Interior of a Saggar
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；12th-13th century；Jian ware: dark gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in iron oxide; the saggar made of coarse reddish buff firing clay. Probably from the kilns at Shuiji, Jianyang county, Fujian province
